job: 67 Hendrefoilan Road, Sketty, Swansea SA2 9LU - Mr S Sparks

stages.title: Version A - as drawn
stages.desc: Exactly the architect's plan: 484 Nudura 6in XR35 forms, 17 stack joints (red) where the runs are off the Nudura Bond. The base follows the falling ground 2 courses below it (-1,104, -1,562, -2,019, -2,476, -2,933), split-level slabs (front 0 / kitchen -1,500), first floor, steels, a trussed main roof (fink trusses @600, valley sets over the bays), a cut vaulted extension roof, windows and plain-wall partitions as design assumptions.

stages.title: Version B - Nudura Bond, no stack joints
stages.desc: The same house with every corner-to-corner run nudged onto the Nudura Bond (width 11,938 v 12,005, depth 9,093 v 9,158, bays / returns / extension within ~115 mm) - 470 forms and ZERO stack joints: faster to build, no joint cutting. The architect / client must accept the nudges before Version B is used.
